mcq_questions.description: ﻿∴dydx=ddx(πx180cos⁡πx180)=π180ddx(x⋅cos⁡πx180)[Product Rule: ddx(uv)=udvdx+vdudx]=π180[1⋅cos⁡πx180+x⋅(−sin⁡πx180⋅π180)]=π180cos⁡πx180−π2x1802sin⁡πx180=π180(cos⁡πx180−πx180sin⁡πx180)\begin{aligned} \therefore \frac{dy}{dx} &= \frac{d}{dx} \left( \frac{\pi x}{180} \cos \frac{\pi x}{180} \right) \\ &= \frac{\pi}{180} \frac{d}{dx} \left( x \cdot \cos \frac{\pi x}{180} \right) \quad \text{[Product Rule: } \frac{d}{dx}(uv) = u\frac{dv}{dx} + v\frac{du}{dx} ] \\ &= \frac{\pi}{180} \left[ 1 \cdot \cos \frac{\pi x}{180} + x \cdot \left( -\sin \frac{\pi x}{180} \cdot \frac{\pi}{180} \right) \right] \\ &= \frac{\pi}{180} \cos \frac{\pi x}{180} - \frac{\pi^2 x}{180^2} \sin \frac{\pi x}{180} \\ &= \frac{\pi}{180} \left( \cos \frac{\pi x}{180} - \frac{\pi x}{180} \sin \frac{\pi x}{180} \right) \end{aligned}∴dxdy​​=dxd​(180πx​cos180πx​)=180π​dxd​(x⋅cos180πx​)[Product Rule: dxd​(uv)=udxdv​+vdxdu​]=180π​[1⋅cos180πx​+x⋅(−sin180πx​⋅180π​)]=180π​cos180πx​−1802π2x​sin180πx​=180π​(cos180πx​−180πx​sin180πx​)​﻿
